decisions.reason: This illuminated candle arch line sits close to the core craft offer and was featured on the home page in both years, so keeping it costs little and its seasonal demand is well understood.
A one-tier pyramid is a staple of the established range that is cheap to keep in a catalog-driven seasonal business, and there is no sign it has failed.
The electronic music box is the firm's flagship diversification option, and adding new discs and platforms in 2019 suggests encouraging results that justify keeping it open rather than abandoning it.
A second edition was released in 2019, which signals positive demand, but as a themed platform distant from the core it is more likely than the others to be replaced by newer motifs.
This Christmas-themed platform fits the seasonal core business and adds value to the music box system at low cost, so the option remains worth holding.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core competencies and was prominently shown in both years, so there is no evidence to warrant abandoning it.
